text:
alex: Hey team, noticed a sustained uptick in corrected ECC and a cluster of Xid31s in us-west-2 over the past 6h. thinking we should prototype a health-scoring metric + dashboard to reduce noisy pages.
maria: Can you drop the prom query you ran so we can validate signal vs noise?
alex: Sure, quick PromQL I used: ```
sum by (gpu_model, region, instance_id) (increase(nvidia_ecc_errors_total[6h]))
/ ignoring(instance_id) group_left() sum by (gpu_model,region) (increase(nvidia_total_ops[6h]))
```
That highlights per-card ECC rate; flagged ~12 cards over 0.5% corrected+uncorrected rate.
gpu-monitor-bot: Alert: us-west-2 GPU ECC rate > 0.5% for 3x10m windows (12 cards). Snapshot saved to gpu-health/bakeoff-2026-03.
jin: @ops_oncall any manual drains or infra work in that AZ? also can you fetch nvml + kernel logs for the worst offenders (gpu-uw2-12, gpu-uw2-19)?
ops_oncall: Two nodes were drained earlier for kernel updates (non-GPU). I pulled nvml on gpu-uw2-12: repeated Xid 31 and spikes of uncorrected ECC. No host-level reboots since last week.
taylor: Proposed approach: introduce a recorded metric infra:gpu:card_health_score (0-100). Weight factors: uncorrected ECC heavy, Xid events, corrected ECC moderate, heartbeat misses low. Visualize as heatmap by region/AZ + failing-cards list.
maria: For SLOs: region-level target: 99.95% of GPUs score >= 70. If a region falls below for 15m, page Ops. Keep a 15m window to reduce churn.
alex: Dashboard should show top failing cards, recent maintenance (who/why), NVML excerpts, and a quick replace cost calc (on-demand vs reserved). Also a little panel estimating latency impact if N GPUs degraded (use perf model).
jin: Implementation note: compute score with recording rules, expose a gauge. Sketch: ```
- record: infra:gpu:card_health_score:ratio
  expr: clamp_min(1 - ( (rate(nvidia_ecc_uncorrected_total[1h]) * 5) + rate(nvidia_ecc_corrected_total[1h]) * 0.5 + rate(nvidia_xid_errors_total[1h]) * 2 + increase(gpu_heartbeat_misses_total[24h]) * 0.1 ), 0)
```
then *100 and cap. We'll tune weights after 24-48h of data.
taylor: Also add repair policy annotations on alerts: soft-drain for score 40-70 (evacuate pods, reprovision drivers), immediate replace if score <40 OR Xid31 >=3 in 24h. That balances safety vs replacement cost.
ops_oncall: I'll draft a runbook snippet for /runbooks/gpu-health: 1) check nvml & dmesg for Xid/ECC, 2) validate temps/power rails, 3) soft-drain + driver/kernel reprovision if only corrected ECC, 4) replace node and tag GPU BAD if uncorrected ECC or >=3 Xid31 in 24h, 5) log incident and link node in dashboard.
maria: Add a "regional SLA exposure" panel mapping degraded GPUs -> expected P95 latency change using our perf model; helps product prioritize replacements vs cost.
gpu-monitor-bot: Dashboard gpu-health/bakeoff-2026-03 created by alex. Daily digest scheduled 08:00 UTC.
ops_oncall: Starting triage on gpu-uw2-12, will paste nvml excerpts and actions here.
alex: thanks all. we'll reconvene after 24h of ingestion to adjust scoring weights and SLO thresholds. Please paste any tuning notes or false positives into this thread.
